subject: Passing multiple values to vjust in theme_text

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: Passing multiple values to vjust in theme_text
parts:
I stumbled across this behavior just recently:

dat <- data.frame(x = letters[1:4], y = 1:4)
ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
geom_point() +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 10, angle = 0, vjust =
c(0,1,0,1)))

which results in a very odd looking graph. I just naively wondered if
I could pass a vector to vjust in this instance, but clearly I can't.
The fact that ggplot didn't throw an error makes me wonder if I'm just
getting the syntax wrong. If this really isn't allowed ever, perhaps
there's a better default behavior? Using just the first value maybe?
